title: MemoryRecordsUpdateRequest
description: Update record content and/or kind. At least one of content/kind is required. Placement changes are not an update — use memory.records.promote. Reflection invalidation commits in the same transaction (MEM-R013). Grant: records_write covering the current placement. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
